The limits: a single entry point, an explicit context, a separate process stopped after one minute, no access to the database, and every run logged. Only arm it for as long as you are using it.

textes.Chaque dépôt de ce document est conservé: Every deposit of this document is kept. The current version is the one the record shows; earlier ones remain readable — a failed scan is corrected by depositing again, losing nothing.

textes.Chaque fichier archivé porte l'empreinte: Every archived file carries the fingerprint of its content. The job server reads a few of them back on each cycle — the least recently checked first — and reports those that no longer match. A disk that degrades gives no warning, and an archive never read back is not an archive.
textes.Chaque foyer range à peu près les mêmes: Every household files roughly the same things. Rather than making you retype what everyone has in common, the installation lays down a ready-made filing — to be pruned afterwards, which takes ten seconds per category, when inventing the missing one takes ten minutes.

textes.Combien de documents le serveur de trava:
How many documents the job server OCRs in parallel (§22.41). **0: automatic** — half the machine's cores, four at most, which is almost always right.

A document takes about seven seconds, spent almost entirely in OCR: one at a time, that is five hundred documents an hour, and taking on a household's existing twenty thousand takes forty hours. Processing three or four at a time divides that accordingly.

Going above half the cores achieves nothing: the OCR runs then fight over the processor instead of sharing it, and the machine becomes slow for everything else — the interface included. The change takes effect within seconds, with no restart: documents in flight run to the end, the next ones use the new setting.

textes.Comme (?i), et ^ $ désignent le début et: Like (?i), and ^ $ mark the start and end of **each line**. Essential for a pattern anchored on a whole line — without it, ^…$ would require the page to fit on a single line, and would therefore never find anything.

Without the archives, a restore would give back a register pointing at files that are not there. Untick this only if you copy `storage/` some other way (a filesystem snapshot, a whole-machine backup).

textes.La date annoncée comme limite de paiemen: The date announced as the payment deadline (“pay before”, “payment due by”, “debited on”). That is the one reminders will hang on.
textes.La date de coupure ne peut pas être post: The cut-off date cannot be later than today: today's events are always kept.
textes.La dernière date rencontrée. Sur beaucou: The last date encountered. On many invoices the first is the issue date and the last is the due date.
textes.La double authentification est déjà acti: Two-factor authentication is already enabled on this account.
textes.La double authentification est exigée su: Two-factor authentication is required on this account: set it up from “My account” to get access back.
Two-factor authentication is required on this account.
textes.La déduction automatique demande une tab: Automatic deduction requires a source table to search in.
textes.La langue du foyer. « Automatique » suit:
The household's language. “Automatic” follows each person's browser. French is the original language: whatever a translation does not cover shows in French rather than blank.

To add one: drop a JSON file into the installation's `langues/` folder — a dictionary from French to your language — then reload the page. Nothing to recompile.
textes.La palette de l'interface. « Automatique:
The interface palette. “Automatic” follows the operating system's light/dark setting.

To add one: drop a JSON file into the installation's `themes/` folder — a key, a name, and the colour variables — then reload the page. An added theme that reuses a shipped theme's key replaces it, which lets you retouch a palette without copying it out.
The attachment to be replaced no longer exists.
textes.La porte de sortie, sous condition : ce: The way out, under conditions: what the screens do not provide for.
The look, for the whole household.
The root of the drop folder cannot be removed.
textes.La saisie devient alors une liste de cho: Entry then becomes a list of choices, and the value saved is the row pointed at: the display follows its name, even when that name changes. Text already entered are not identifiers — the server will say how many need redoing.
textes.La sauvegarde automatique est éteinte. V: Automatic backup is off. You can trigger one here, but nothing will happen on its own.
textes.La tâche a échoué autant de fois que le: The task failed as many times as the configured threshold allows: the server will no longer pick it up on its own. That is the point of the threshold — an unrecoverable document must not run forever. Examine the received file, correct what needs correcting, then replay: the task starts from scratch.
textes.La tâche est en file : le serveur la pre: The task is queued: the server will pick it up on its next pass.
textes.La valeur se choisit dans une table du f: The value is chosen from a household table or among the accounts: a vehicle, a member, an issuer. It can also be deduced from the text.
textes.La vue s'ouvre alors sur des branches —: The view then opens on branches — « 2026 », then « EDF » — rather than on three hundred rows. Dates fold by year.
textes.Langues cherchées dans les documents sca: Languages looked for in scanned documents, Tesseract-style: “fra”, or “fra+eng” for a household that also receives English documents. Each added language slows processing a little.
textes.Le PDF entier, feuilletable dans le pann: The whole PDF, browsable in the panel.
textes.Le PDF part en corbeille: The PDF goes to the bin
textes.Le champ contient des documents déjà cla: The field holds documents already filed, which are pointed at instead of being copied — « Linked invoices », « Quotes received ».
textes.Le changer referme toutes les autres ses: Changing it closes every other session open on this account — deliberately: a password one changes is often a password one believes someone else knows. This one stays open.
textes.Le chemin **vu par le conteneur**. Le do: The path **as seen by the container**. The shipped folder is mounted from `./sauvegardes`; to write elsewhere — an external disk, a network share — mount it in docker-compose.yml and give its inside path here. A backup on the same disk as the data protects against a slip of the hand, not against a disk failure.
textes.Le choix se combine avec l'état retenu a: The choice combines with the state selected above. A task appears here only once its document is created: before that, it has no type yet.
The household's filing cabinet, kept by HomeGED.
textes.Le compte consulté n'existe plus ou a ét: The account being viewed no longer exists or has been disabled.
textes.Le contexte doit être un objet JSON — «: The context must be a JSON object — “{"lignes": [1, 2]}”.
textes.Le document auquel joindre cette pièce n: The document this attachment belongs to no longer exists.
textes.Le document est indexé et complet. Ces t: The document is indexed and complete. These tasks are purged automatically after the configured delay, along with the received file they were keeping.
textes.Le document existe et il est lisible, ma: The document exists and is readable, but it is missing a field its type requires. It does not appear in the register as long as it is incomplete. Complete it from the review centre, or correct the rule that should have found it — the automatic retry will come back to it within five minutes.
textes.Le décalage s'exprime en nombre de jours: The shift is expressed in days: “30”, or “-7” to go backwards.
textes.Le délai entre deux sauvegardes. Vingt-q: The gap between two backups. Twenty-four hours suits a household: at worst you lose a day of uploads, and lost documents can be uploaded again. Going lower only makes sense on a very busy installation.
The drop folder is in order.
textes.Le fichier a été déposé à un endroit qu': The file was dropped somewhere no document type claims. It has not been read — as long as we do not know what it is, recognised text would be of no use. State its type from the review centre: it will join the right folder and processing will start over.
textes.Le fichier d'origine n'est plus disponib: The original file is no longer available: the job was purged, or dropped before their retention was set up.
textes.Le fichier de cette version n'est plus s: The file for this version is no longer on disk.
textes.Le fichier est facultatif : glissez-le e: The file is optional: drop it later, or never
textes.Le fichier exporté depuis une autre inst: The file exported from another HomeGED installation.
textes.Le fichier reçu n'est plus disponible :: The received file is no longer available: this job can no longer be filed.
The received file is no longer available: it cannot be filed.
The received file is no longer available.
textes.Le fichier reçu sera effacé, et le trava: The received file will be erased, and the job will stay visible in the follow-up with the trace of who discarded it. It does not enter the register, so there is no bin to catch it.
textes.Le montant de TVA annoncé (« TVA 20 % »,: The VAT amount announced (“VAT 20%”, “of which VAT”).
textes.Le montant hors taxes, à condition qu'il: The amount excluding tax, provided it is announced “Total excl. VAT”, “Net amount”… Without a label nothing is returned: a pre-tax amount cannot be guessed.
textes.Le mot de passe doit faire au moins 10 c: The password must be at least 10 characters.
textes.Le navigateur refuse l'accès au presse-p: The browser refuses access to the clipboard.
textes.Le nombre de lignes est celui qu'estime: The number of rows is the engine's estimate: it approximates, it does not count.
textes.Le nouveau mot de passe est identique à: The new password is the same as the old one.
textes.Le numéro d'entreprise de l'émetteur, ch: The issuer's company number, digits only. It identifies a company unambiguously, where its name varies from one letterhead to the next.
textes.Le point d'entrée. Ce qu'il rend est aff: The entry point. What it returns is shown below.
textes.Le retirer de cette liste. L'administrat: Remove it from this list. The administrator can still recover it.
textes.Le réglage de départ ; chacun peut le ch: The starting setting; everyone can change it from the pagination.
textes.Le second facteur sera retiré : le mot d: The second factor will be removed: the password alone will be enough to get in again.
textes.Le serveur ne sait pas lire ce format :: The server cannot read this format: it would stay here indefinitely, with no task and no message. Filing it elsewhere would change nothing — it just has to be removed.
textes.Le serveur qui expédie les messages : ce: The server that sends the messages: your provider's or your mailbox's. Example: smtp.example.net.
textes.Le serveur y travaille en ce moment. L'o: The server is working on it right now. Text recognition is the long step.
The theme chosen in the administration.
textes.Le thème d'origine : chemise cartonnée v: The original theme: a green cardboard folder on cream paper. Restful for long filing sessions.
textes.Le traitement s'est interrompu : fichier: Processing broke off: unreadable file, text recognition impossible. No document was created. The received file is kept — examine it, then replay the task.
textes.Le verrou se libère de lui-même après qu: The lock releases itself after a few minutes of inactivity.
textes.Les PDF partent en corbeille, pas à la p: PDFs go to the bin, not to the rubbish
textes.Les catégories se reconnaissent, les mon: Categories are recognised, amounts and dates fill themselves in.
textes.Les codes actuels cesseront d'être valab: The current codes will stop working — one makes new codes precisely because one no longer knows what became of the old ones.
textes.Les colonnes masquées ci-dessus n'appara: The columns hidden above do not appear in the table. Tick them so they stay readable in the metadata, when opening a document of this type.
textes.Les comptes de la GED conviennent quand: Archive accounts suit when the person concerned signs in; a household table, when they have no account — a child, a parent whose papers you keep.
textes.Les critères se cumulent : un document d: The criteria add up: a document must satisfy them all to appear in the view.
textes.Les critères se cumulent. Choisir un dos: The criteria add up. Choosing a folder counts every one of its document types — that is how a whole is measured.
textes.Les dates et heures affichées sont conve: Dates and times shown are converted to this zone. Everything stays stored in universal time: changing this setting alters no data, only the reading.
textes.Les dates sont enregistrées en temps uni: Dates are stored in universal time and read in this zone. This setting can be changed at any time, without altering anything already stored.
textes.Les documents et les fichiers ne sont pa: Documents and files are not touched
textes.Les droits s'accordent catégorie par cat: Rights are granted category by category, for the whole household.
textes.Les entrées plus anciennes sont effacées: Older entries are cleared each night. 0: nothing is purged automatically — purging then stays a decision taken by hand. A document's history is never touched.
textes.Les examens sans suite y figurent aussi: Examinations that led to nothing appear too: « why did this rule do nothing » is the question one asks most often.
textes.Les fiches s'enchaînent : enregistrer pa: Records follow one another: saving moves to the next.
textes.Les fichiers stockés correspondent-ils e: Do the stored files still match what was put in them?
textes.Les fichiers écartés au dépôt et gardés: Files rejected on upload and kept in the bin for longer than this are destroyed. 0: never — the bin is the last net before permanent loss. No effect on documents deleted from the register, set below.
The indicators must be a list.
textes.Les mêmes teintes dans l'autre sens : en: The same tones the other way round: light ink on a dark ground. For working in the evening without lighting up the room.
textes.Les plus anciennes sont effacées au-delà: The oldest are cleared beyond this count. Seven daily backups cover a week — enough to notice a mistake and go back before it.
textes.Les positions ne sont pas lisibles pour: The positions cannot be read for this document.
textes.Les rappels d'échéance et les messages d: Due-date reminders and automation messages also go out by email, as a spaced-out digest. Without it they exist only inside the application — which means opening it.
textes.Les tables de référence du foyer : émett: The household's reference tables: issuers, vehicles, people…
textes.Les tâches terminées et les doublons dis: Finished jobs and duplicates disappear from the tracking after this long, along with the received file they were keeping. Anything calling for action — to be filed, blocked, failed — is never purged: making it disappear would make the problem be forgotten. 0: nothing is purged automatically.
textes.Les véhicules du foyer, pour y rattacher: The household's vehicles, to attach insurance, servicing and fines to.
textes.Lever tous les verrous et remettre les c: Lift every lock and reset the counters?
textes.Lignes par page du registre: Rows per page in the register
textes.Lire ce document ici — clic molette pour: Read this document here — middle-click to open it in a tab
textes.Lire cette pièce — clic molette pour l'o: Read this part — middle-click to open it in a tab
textes.Mettre ce document à la corbeille: Move this document to the bin
textes.Mettre ce fichier à la corbeille: Move this file to the bin
textes.Mettre la date au bon format: Put the date in the right format
textes.Mettre le nombre au bon format: Put the number in the right format
textes.Montant TTC (total TTC / à payer): Amount incl. VAT (total incl. VAT / amount due)
textes.Mot de passe changé. Les autres sessions: Password changed. The other open sessions have been closed.
textes.Mot de passe oublié ? Un administrateur: Forgotten password? A household administrator can reset it from the administration area.
textes.Mémoriser ces filtres comme une vue réut: Save these filters as a reusable view
textes.Ménage automatique : {n} ligne(s) de sui: Automatic cleanup: {n} old tracking row(s) cleared
textes.N'agit pas sur le document : sert à repé: Does nothing to the document: it spots a situation without changing anything. This is how you try a rule out before giving it actions.
textes.Noir sur blanc, traits marqués. Pour une: Black on white, strong lines. For tired eyes, a poor screen, or a room in full sun.
textes.Nom du fichier tel qu'il a été déposé: File name as it was dropped
textes.Nombre d'échecs de connexion tolérés ava: How many failed sign-ins are tolerated before the address is shut out for a while. Too low and you lock yourself out with a slip of the finger.
textes.Nombre de fichiers relus à chaque cycle: How many files are read back on each maintenance cycle to check they have not changed since being archived. Least recently checked first: the archive cycles through on its own without ever being read in one go. 0: no checking — a disk going bad gives no warning.
textes.Nécessite le fichier d'origine (travaux: Requires the original file (failed jobs, quarantined file).
textes.Obligatoire (un document sans cette vale: Required (a document without this value will be flagged)
textes.Ordre retenu — faites glisser pour le ch: Order kept — drag to change it
textes.Organise le classement. Ne contient aucu: Organises the filing. Holds no document of its own, and therefore has neither columns nor expected fields.
textes.Ouvrez votre application d'authentificat: Open your authenticator application (Google Authenticator, Aegis, Bitwarden, 1Password…) and scan this code. It will then show six digits, renewed every thirty seconds.
Open your authenticator application and copy the six digits shown for HomeGED.
textes.Ouvrir en plein écran, dans un onglet: Open full screen, in a tab
textes.Ouvrir le champ : la déduction se règle: Open the field: the deduction is set on it
textes.Ouvrir le registre tel que {qui} le voit: Open the register as {qui} sees it
textes.Ouvrir un document et y désigner la vale: Open a document and point at the value to extract
textes.Pas d'appareil photo ? Saisissez cette c: No camera? Enter this key by hand:
textes.Pendant qu'une fiche est ouverte en modi: While a record is open for editing, nobody else can write to it. The lock releases itself after this long, in case the window was left open.
textes.Personnes auxquelles un document peut êt: People a document can be attached to. Independent of the sign-in accounts.
textes.Pièce principale — c'est elle que le reg: Main part — this is the one the register opens.
textes.Pièce reçue. Elle apparaîtra ici dans qu: Part received. It will appear here in a few seconds, once it has been read.
textes.Placer cette pièce après la suivante: Place this part after the next one
textes.Placer cette pièce avant la précédente: Place this part before the previous one
textes.Porte les documents de cette sorte, et t: Holds documents of this kind, and everything that describes them. It is a leaf of the tree: it takes no sub-category.
textes.Pour les valeurs qu'on compare plutôt qu: For values that get compared rather than read: a scan yields “Hélène” or “Helene” depending on its quality.
textes.Pour un code, une plaque, une référence: For a code, a plate, a reference — so the document's casing does not make two values.
textes.Prévenir combien de jours avant: How many days ahead to warn
textes.Prévenir si rien n'est sauvegardé depuis: Warn if nothing has been backed up for
textes.Purge automatique du journal d'audit: Automatic purge of the audit log
textes.Quand c'est actif, le serveur de travaux: When this is on, the job server copies the database and the archives at the chosen pace. Nothing is backed up while this setting is off: the application does not decide on your behalf to fill a disk.
textes.Quand l'expression capture plusieurs mor: When the pattern captures several pieces — a first name and a surname, a two-part reference — joins them back with the given separator, instead of writing two rules for one field.
textes.Quand un document arrive et que…, alors…: When a document arrives and…, then… — set here, not in the code.
textes.Quatre catégories — factures, impôts, ba: Four categories — invoices, taxes, bank, letters — the rules for reading a French invoice, and the household members. Enough to start with nothing to remove.
textes.Qui a ouvert quel document est tracé (§2: Who opened which document is recorded (§21.16). Those rows are numerous and age fast: past this long they are cleared. The rest of a document's history — upload, change, deletion — is never purged. 0: keep everything.
textes.Qui entre, combien de temps, et à quelle: Who gets in, for how long, and on what terms. These settings used to live in the .env file, out of an administrator's reach.
Who can see and change what.
textes.Quitter cette fiche pour la sienne: Leave this record for its own
textes.Rattaché dès qu'une colonne cherchée fig: Linked as soon as one searched column appears in the document
textes.Rattaché quand toutes les colonnes cherc: Linked when every searched column appears in the document
textes.Rechargez la page pour voir le nouveau c: Reload the page to see the new filing in the navigation.
textes.Rechercher un document, un émetteur, un: Search a document, an issuer, a vehicle…
textes.Recherches mémorisées, proposées dans la: Remembered searches, offered in the navigation.
textes.Recontrôle seulement les champs exigés p: Rechecks only the fields the category requires.
textes.Relancer ce travail à partir d'une étape: Restart this job from a step
textes.Relier ces fiches entre elles : un contr: Link these records together: a contract and its amendment, an invoice and its dispute
textes.Relit le texte du PDF sans refaire l'OCR: Reads the PDF text again without redoing OCR.
textes.Rend en aaaa-mm-jj la date contenue dans: Renders as yyyy-mm-dd the date contained in what the pattern found, however it is written. Useful when a document carries ten dates and a pattern points at the right one.
textes.Renseigne au moins un champ avant d'enre: Fill in at least one field before saving.
textes.Repartir des colonnes déduites: Go back to the deduced columns
textes.Reprendre un champ que vos règles d'extr: Take a field your extraction rules already fill, or a column of the document such as its date.
textes.Rescan reçu. Il remplacera cette pièce d: Rescan received. It will replace this part in a few seconds; the previous version stays in its history.
textes.Restreint ce rôle à certaines valeurs :: Restricts this role to certain values: « only 2025 and 2026 », « only this vehicle ». With no tick at all on a field, that field restricts nothing.
textes.Retire les espaces de ce que l'expressio: Removes the spaces from what the pattern found, non-breaking ones included — OCR scatters them through serial numbers and IBANs.
textes.Retire tout ce qui n'est pas un chiffre: Removes everything that is not a digit from what the pattern found: “No. 026 580 4351” becomes “0265804351”.
textes.Retirer l'exception : cette catégorie su: Remove the exception: this category will follow its folder
textes.Retiré de sa propre corbeille : lui ne l: Removed from their own bin: they no longer see it
textes.Retrouver ce réglage la prochaine fois,: Find this setting again next time, without retyping it
textes.Rien : la catégorie a tout ce qu'elle at: Nothing: the category has everything it expects.
textes.Rien de coché : ce que la table déclare,: Nothing ticked: whatever the table declares, that is {colonnes}. Tick to choose something else here — the setting applies to this field only.
Nothing declared — the usual case. An invoice gains from carrying an identifying field (its number); a contract, a deadline.
textes.Rien de plus à en dire d'ici : ouvrez sa: Nothing more to say about it from here: open its record.
Nothing was pointed at on the document.
textes.Rien n'entre tout seul dans une fiche :: Nothing enters a record on its own: the file is dropped in
textes.Rien n'est détruit : l'administration po: Nothing is destroyed: the administrator can still recover them.
textes.Rien n'est perdu : vos documents sont en: Nothing is lost: your documents are in the database, and this interruption only affected the display. Carry on below, or move to another screen.
textes.Rien ne correspond à « {terme} » dans ce: Nothing matches “{terme}” in this scope — try “Everything”.
textes.Rien à la racine, et aucun dossier qui n: Nothing at the root, and no folder that does not belong to a document type.
textes.Rien à raconter : ce document n'a pas ét: Nothing to tell: this document has not been changed since it arrived.
textes.Réapplique regex d'émetteur, de catégori: Reapplies the issuer, category and field patterns. Immediate.
textes.Réocérise le PDF archivé, puis rejoue la: Re-runs OCR on the archived PDF, then replays the rest. Slow.
textes.Résidence, garage, terrain : ce à quoi r: Home, garage, land: what to attach a lease, a property tax or building work to.
textes.S'applique aux mots de passe créés ou ch: Applies to passwords created or changed after this setting. Existing passwords are not invalidated — that would lock everyone out.
textes.STARTTLS commence en clair puis chiffre: STARTTLS starts in the clear then encrypts; SSL encrypts from the start. “None” sends credentials and messages in the clear over the network.
textes.Saisissez l'un des codes de secours noté: Enter one of the recovery codes written down when you set this up. Each one works only once.
textes.Sans expression de reconnaissance, ce je: Without a recognition pattern this set would never be chosen. Give it a pattern, or make it the type's generic set.
textes.Sans expression régulière, choisissez un: With no regular expression, choose a function that searches on its own — “First date in the document” or “Amount incl. VAT”. The others only transform what a pattern found.
textes.Ses actions restent au journal d'audit: Its actions stay in the audit log
textes.Session close : le mot de passe du compt: Session closed: the account password has changed.
Session must be renewed: sign in again.
textes.Seul l'ajout est possible : modifier ou: Only adding is possible: changing or removing an existing column would destroy the values already entered.
Only an administrator can remove it.
textes.Seules les paires déclarées ci-dessous p: Only the pairs declared below can be.
textes.Seuls les champs qui concernent ce type: Only the fields that concern this type are offered: the columns every document carries, what this type declares it expects, what its rules write, and what its documents already carry.
textes.Sombre et froid, bleu-gris. Les couleurs: Dark and cool, blue-grey. Status colours stand out more than on Night: prefer it when watching jobs.
textes.Sortir ces documents dans une archive ra: Export these documents into an archive arranged from a template
textes.Sortir tous les documents en .zip, rangé: Export every document as a .zip, arranged according to their filing.
textes.Sources verrouillées après trop d'échecs: Sources locked after too many failures, and unlocking.
textes.Suivi des traitements, diagnostic des éc: Follow-up of processing, diagnosis of failures and restarts.
textes.Supprimer ce dossier (seulement s'il est: Delete this folder (only if it is empty)
textes.Supprimer cette archive et son fichier: Delete this archive and its file
textes.Sélection, boutons principaux, colonnes: Selection, main buttons, filtered columns. The original green is that of a cardboard folder.
textes.Table « {table} » supprimée avec ses {n}: Table “{table}” deleted along with its {n} row(s)
textes.Tant qu'aucune paire n'est déclarée ici,: As long as no pair is declared here, anything can be linked to anything.
textes.Tant qu'elle n'est pas configurée, ce co: Until it is set up, this account can sign in but only reaches the « My account » page.
textes.Tapez au moins trois caractères. La rech: Type at least three characters. The search goes through the issuer, the extracted fields, the file name, the filing, the text of the documents and the things they concern.
textes.Tirer pour élargir les métadonnées — dou: Drag to widen the metadata — double-click for the original width
textes.Tous les documents classés respectent le: Every filed document meets the expected fields of its category.
textes.Tout ce que porte ce fichier existait dé: Everything this file carries already existed, under the same names.
textes.Tout ce qui décrit un type, dans l'ordre: Everything that describes a type, in order: fields, columns, rules.

Everything that describes a type, in the order one thinks of it. The fields first: the columns are chosen among them, the rules fill them, and deadlines are properties of fields. Each step stays editable from its usual screen.
textes.Tout le classement et les réglages, sans: All the filing and settings, without the accounts or the archive export.
textes.Tout reprendre depuis le fichier source: Redo everything from the source file
textes.Tout régler pour un type, dans l'ordre: Set everything up for a type, in order
textes.Toutes les archives sont passées par l'o: Every archive has been through the optimiser.
textes.Toutes les colonnes cherchées doivent fi: Every column looked for must be present
textes.Trace des actions importantes. Consultat: Trace of the important actions. Read-only.
textes.Travail introuvable, ou déjà classé: Job not found, or already filed
textes.Trois chemises cartonnées empilées, dans: Three stacked cardboard folders, with a sheet being filed into them
textes.Trouve la première date, quelle que soit: Finds the first date, however it is written — 21/08/26, 2026-08-21 or “21 August 2026” — and returns it in the database format. No pattern to write.
textes.Type de la colonne à ajouter: Type of the column to add
textes.Téléchargez-le d'abord si vous n'êtes pa: Download it first if you are not sure
textes.Téléphone perdu : retirer le second fact: Phone lost: remove the second factor
textes.Un IBAN, sans espaces. Le format est vér: An IBAN, without spaces. The format is checked, not the check digits: OCR confusing 8 and B would make the value unusable when it is one click away from being fixed.
textes.Un administrateur exige la double authen: An administrator requires two-factor authentication on this account: it cannot be disabled here.
An administrator requires two-factor authentication on this account.
textes.Un administrateur voit et modifie toutes: An administrator sees and edits every category. Other accounts inherit the rights of the roles assigned to them (set in the « Roles & rights » tab) — handy to give access to a single member of the household without opening every document to them.
textes.Un code à usage unique, lu sur votre tél: A one-time code, read on your phone, is added to the password. A stolen password is then no longer enough to get in.
textes.Un compte désactivé ne verrait rien: A disabled account would see nothing
textes.Un document auquel il manque un champ ex: A document missing a field required by its category is not filed yet: it does not count, unless asked for here.
textes.Un document qui pointait cette ligne gar: A document that pointed at this row will keep an empty reference
textes.Un document supprimé du registre part en: A document deleted from the register goes to the bin and stays readable there. Past this long it is destroyed for good, with its file. 0: never — this is a household, space is rarely short, and a paper thought useless sometimes serves again years later.
textes.Un dossier porte un numéro, repris sur l: A case carries a number, repeated on the quote, the order form, the delivery note: declare here that this field links them, and opening one will show the others. The declaration works both ways, and views inherit it — it belongs to the type, not to the screen.
textes.Un dépôt qui échoue est retenté ; passé: A failed upload is retried; past this count it is marked as permanently failed and automatic retry ignores it — it stays visible in the job server, and a replay requested by hand starts from scratch. Same threshold for retries of a stuck job. 0: never give up.
textes.Un fichier identique au bit près était d: A file identical to the bit was already known — as a document or as a version. Nothing was added: there was nothing new to record.
textes.Un fichier mis à la corbeille n'est pas: A file moved to the bin is not destroyed: it stays recoverable there for the retention period. What sits here may have arrived by mistake, and destruction is decided knowingly.
textes.Un mot de passe est requis à la création: A password is required on creation
textes.Un numéro français, rendu en dix chiffre: A French number, returned as ten digits with no separators — however it is written on the document.
textes.Un résumé espacé de ce que personne n'a: A spaced-out summary of what nobody has read, never one message per event. Unticking loses nothing: the reminders stay in the application. Sending also depends on the household setting.
A role says what one can do, and where. Six actions per place — view, edit, deposit, download, move to the bin, manage versions — plus the rights that depend on no category. An account adds up its roles: what one grants, no other takes away. An administrator reaches everything without going through them. Unfiled documents stay visible to every signed-in account, but only an administrator can destroy them.
textes.Un scan lit « 0range » pour « Orange »,: A scan reads « 0range » for « Orange », « Dupond » for « Dupont ». To be kept for names: on a registration plate or a contract number, one letter separates two different rows. Short words stay exact whatever happens.
textes.Un seul dépôt pour l'instant. Redéposer: Only one deposit so far. Depositing the same document again — rescanned, corrected — will add one here rather than creating a second record.
textes.Un seul espace là où l'OCR en a semé plu: A single space where OCR scattered several, and none at the ends: “Jean   DUPONT” and “Jean DUPONT” must not make two different values in a table that sorts them.
textes.Un tableau de bord réunit des indicateur: A dashboard gathers indicators: a total, a count, a breakdown or a trend. Each is described by what it measures, over what scope and over what period — the home board, itself, ships with the application and cannot be changed.
textes.Un trou vide disparaît du nom : l'archiv: An empty placeholder disappears from the name: the archive is read by someone who has never seen your templates.
textes.Une archive non téléchargée s'efface d'e: An archive that is not downloaded erases itself after this long. An export left on the disk is a complete copy of the household waiting for its moment.
textes.Une archive rangée comme vous la voulez,: An archive arranged as you want it, built by the server
textes.Une catégorie ne peut pas être rattachée: A category cannot be attached to itself or to one of its sub-categories
textes.Une colonne sans champ n'a rien à affich: A column with no field has nothing to show
textes.Une date qui arrive à terme : fin de val: A date that falls due: end of validity, payment deadline, end of warranty. The household is warned before it passes, and the document appears in the « Deadlines » screen.
textes.Une seule trouvée suffit. À réserver aux: One match is enough. To be kept for values that do not repeat elsewhere — a registration plate, a contract number. On a surname, this setting would link the wrong person.
textes.Une table source ne peut être associée q: A source table can only be linked to a custom field (meta:…).
textes.Une valeur que vous nommez et dont vous: A value you name and whose type you choose — « what was done », « mileage », « date of work ». This is the usual case.
textes.Une vignette de la première page, et cel: A thumbnail of the first page, and those of the linked documents side by side. The PDF is not loaded: you recognise without waiting.
textes.Une vue est une lecture préfiltrée du re: A view is a pre-filtered reading of the register. With no tick here, each view stays offered according to its own sharing — restricting is possible, not compulsory.
textes.Vidage automatique de la corbeille des d: Automatic emptying of the upload bin
textes.Vide : la sauvegarde reste un dossier li:
Blank: the backup stays a folder readable as it is — which is what makes it restorable in ten years without this application.

Set, each backup becomes **a single encrypted file** in AES-256 (`.tar.gz.enc`). A backup often goes elsewhere — an external disk in a drawer, a network share, a disk that will be sold one day — and it holds every one of the household's papers. Encryption answers that moment, not another.

What that implies: decryption goes through `openssl`, a standard tool, and the exact command is written in the clear next to the archive — nothing specific to this code is needed to read it back. On the other hand, **lose this password and the backup is lost**: no recovery exists, that is the point. Write it down somewhere other than this installation. Encryption also means copying everything each time: expect twice the space for the duration of the backup, and a little more time.

Kept for the backup and never shown again. Backups already made are untouched: the change applies to the next ones.
textes.Vide : trente jours — le temps de s'occu: Empty: thirty days — enough time to deal with an insurance policy or a roadworthiness test without the reminder becoming noise.
textes.Vignettes : ce document et ceux qui lui: Thumbnails: this document and those linked to it, side by side — the PDF is not loaded

textes.Vous pouvez aussi taper directement dans: You can also type straight into the column: « 04/09/2026 » for a day, « 09/2026 » for a whole month, « 2026 » for the whole year.
textes.^ $ désignent le début et la fin de chaq: ^ $ mark the start and end of each line, but “Invoice” and “invoice” stay two different things. Rare: keep it for patterns where casing carries meaning.

textes.« 1 234,56 € » devient « 1234.56 » : ce: “1,234.56 €” becomes “1234.56”: what the pattern captured, made comparable and computable.
textes.« Compacte » resserre les lignes : plus: “Compact” tightens the rows: more documents on screen, a little less air between them.
textes.« facture », « Facture » et « FACTURE »: “invoice”, “Invoice” and “INVOICE” are all recognised the same way. This is almost always what you want on OCR'd text: casing depends on the layout of the paper, not on its content.
textes.À cocher pour déménager votre installati: Tick it to move your installation elsewhere; leave it unticked to publish a template: these rows are personal data, not structure.
textes.Écrire une note dans le journal: Write a note in the log
textes.Écrit une valeur dans une métadonnée du: Writes a value into a document metadata field. By default it leaves anything already filled alone — a hand-typed value beats ours.
